intro: Your gift reaches children, women and communities in AWSAR's programmes. Fill in your details, then scan the QR code with any UPI app to give.
data.taxNote: An 80G receipt is available when you share your PAN.

body: Gifts from outside India go only to AWSAR's designated FCRA account, by bank transfer (wire/SWIFT) or an online payment link if available. Contact AWSAR for the account details.
